disposition_reason: Table 3 prints dry-weight means of 32 elements, including lead, cadmium, arsenic, mercury, aluminum, tin and nickel, for ten commercial matcha powders.

study.design: Nutritional and elemental composition of ten commercial matcha teas with intake estimates
study.market: health-food stores, bought 2017 and 2019; three provided by a distributor in Slusovice, Czech Republic
study.period_text: bought in 2017 and 2019; analysed within four weeks
study.method: Microwave acid digestion and quadrupole ICP-MS (Thermo iCAP Qc, He KED mode)
study.lod_text: LOQ for Ga, Ta, Pb and U < 0.01 ng/g; other LOD/LOQ not printed in main text
study.qa: CRMs Metranal 8 green algae, INCT-TL-1 tea leaves, NIST 1568b rice flour and IAEA lichen; results in Supplementary Table S3 (not available)
